notes.title: Bonus Words 2.0 and Write Warz Future plans
notes.content:
[b][h3]What’s new in v01.03.05[/h3][/b]

[h2][b]Bonus Words 2.0 (multiplier scoring)[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979424/7a4666a933216c8ebbcad8950856c6cf1bbd725e.gif[/img]

Bonus Words aren’t a novelty anymore—they’re a strategy. When you build your sentence around Bonus Words and receive at least [b]2 votes[/b], you’ll earn:


[list]
[*] 1st word: [b]+10[/b] points
[*] 2nd word: [b]+20[/b]
[*] 3rd word: [b]+40[/b]
That’s[b] +70[/b] points for three in a round. Any words beyond the third (super rare) are [b]+10[/b] each.
[/list]


We also added a new [b]announcement effect[/b] when you land a Bonus Word so the moment feels tactile, funny, and satisfying.

[h2][b]How to get Bonus Words[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Character abilities[/b] can grant (or remove) them—timing abilities matters more now.
[*] [b]Catch-up[/b] rule: if you’re in the bottom half, you’ll always have at least 2 Bonus Words tied to your character’s lore.
[*] [b]Themes:[/b] some themes hand out more. In Pirate, you can buy up to 3 words at each port—now very valuable.
[/list]

Please tell us how this feels—we’ll keep tuning based on your feedback.

[b][h1]Other improvements[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] More consistent text rendering while typing
[*] Fixed unintended “vote for yourself” bug
[*] Faster gold distribution when lots of gold is awarded (Pirate)
[*] Pirate gold conversion now always converts all gold to points
[*] Fixed ink blob animations throughout menus
[*] Fixed Scriptorium shadows across resolutions
[*] Reduced duration/particle count for Pirate gold-earn VFX
[*] Clearer bundle rotation in Marketplace
[*] Fixed scrolling issues (Escape menu, Lobby, Market)
[*] Fixed tooltip spam that showed “AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA”
[*] Fixed rare story display bug with very long words/sentences
[*] Fixed redeem code button missing in certain cases
[/list]

[b][h2]Coming up:[/h2][/b]

[h1][b]Sept 16 — Bumbly’s Rockin’ Adventure (LTM)[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979424/c17452bc45f633028710870bfb15908f80bc9972.png[/img]

Everyone plays as Bumbly. Start with a Mad Libs–style [b]Madtag [/b]sheet, write around your tags, and during voting someone else’s tag can replace yours for maximum chaos. If your tag appears in the winning sentence, [b]you also score[/b]. Then jump into [b]Keytar Hero[/b], our synthwave typing mini-game.
Limited-time: runs ~1 month starting Sept 16. Unlockable content (including Bumbly) during the event.

[h1][b]October — Season Launch: Elves vs Samurai[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979424/b2fdc8c946f344ef65aba2bc0ff5e08ff45ed61f.png[/img]

Teams split into Elves and Samurai. Tight votes can trigger [b]duels [/b]to swing the round, and you’ll earn [b]War Points[/b] for your side. At game end, the faction with the most War Points gets a [b]big bonus[/b] that can flip the outcome.

[h2][b]From the team: where we’re headed (and why)[/b][/h2]
 
We’ve been honest that Early Access is an adventure. Write Warz started as a competitive writing game with a light, cosmetics-only economy. Along the way we learned two big things: 1) the systems we built around progression and monetization didn’t land the way we hoped, and 2) the game absolutely shines when it’s treated like a party game, friends laughing, tossing lines back and forth, and celebrating the clever (or unhinged) sentence that wins the round.
 
So we’re steering toward what feels best to play and most sustainable to support.
 
First, the good news for anyone jumping in: Horror and Pirate will remain free so there’s always a base set of themes you can enjoy without spending a dime. Starting with Elves vs Samurai in October, our new seasonal themes will be DLC. We bundle everything that used to be a grind including fonts and colors, characters, emotes etc. So if you pick up a theme you get the full package instantly. It’s cleaner, clearer, and it lets us fund more of the content you actually play.
 
We’re also making this easier for groups: only the host needs to own a DLC for everyone to play that theme together. If there are six of you, get one friend to grab the pack and the whole table can jump in.  We’ll still have a few bigger cosmetic bundles in the store, but most new goodies will live inside each seasonal theme where they belong.
 
Another change: for now, we’re putting matchmaking on the shelf. The best sessions we see are with friends—online or in the same room—so we’re designing around that. Bots remain in Custom Games to fill a seat or two, and we’ll keep listening if you want other ways to find players later.
 
To make party nights even easier, we’re heads-down on phone play. The goal is simple: host on a computer (more platforms to come), and let everyone else join from their phones, Jackbox-style. This takes engineering time, and we want to do it right, but it’s a top priority for the next few months.
 
Finally, a small tease: pieces are already falling into place for Season 2, a Dungeons-and-Dragons-themed season we’re very excited about. We’ll share more when it’s closer.
 
If you’ve been with us through the experiments and growing pains - thank you. These changes are about making the game feel as joyful as the nights you’ve already shared, while giving us a sustainable way to keep building new themes, characters, and modes. Tell us what works, what doesn’t, and what you want next. We’re listening, and we’re building Write Warz with you.

notes.title: Twitch Mode Now Live! + Limited LTM Preview
notes.content:
[h1]Write Warz Update v01.03.03 — Twitch Mode Is Live![/h1]



Twitch Voting Integration is now available in Write Warz! Your livestream audience can vote in real time on which sentence wins each round, giving streamers and communities a new way to shape the story together.



[h2]What is Write Warz?[/h2]

Write Warz is a free-to-play party storytelling game where up to 6 players pick a theme, everyone writes a one-line continuation to the story prompt, and then the group votes. The winning sentence is added to the story. Character abilities, mini-games, and events keep each round fresh and surprising.



[h2]How to Host with Twitch Voting[/h2]



From the Main Menu, click [b]Play [/b]→ [b]Custom Games[/b]. The host selects[b] Create Match[/b].

Twitch Voting Integration: ON

Enter your [b]Twitch username[/b] exactly and click Check Username. Our bot will follow you, enabling chat voting in your game.





[b]Voting Mode[/b]



[list]
[*] [b]Player Priority[/b]— Chat can vote, but all of chat’s votes together count as one total vote.
[*] [b]Split Decision[/b] — Chat receives votes equal to the number of players, distributed by chat’s percentages (e.g., with 2 players, chat has 2 total votes).
[*] [b]Twitch Rules[/b] — In-game players do not vote; the audience decides 100%.
[/list]




Once in-game players have voted, you may close audience voting early by clicking [b]End Chat Voting[/b] before the timer expires.







[h2]Limited-Time Preview: Bumbly’s Rockin’ Adventure (LTM)[/h2]

As part of our back-to-school celebration, we’re offering a limited preview of [b]Bumbly’s Rockin’ Adventure[/b] available through [b]September 1[/b].


[b]How it works[/b]



[list]
[*] Begin with a short, Mad Libs–inspired questionnaire.
[*] Use your tags as guidance to write your sentence.
[*] Enter the voting round and see the mayhem unfold.
[/list]





[b]This mode is in beta[/b]. You may encounter occasional issues. We’re aware of a bug where the “Previous Sentence(s)” panel may not display the correct text during the voting round. Please report any other problems via our Discord.







[h2]Join the Community & Share Feedback[/h2]

[url=www.discord.gg/writewarz]www.discord.gg/writewarz[/url] — Tell us how Twitch voting feels, which mode you prefer, and what you’d like to see next.




Thanks for being part of the Write Warz community. See you at the stream!

We’ve officially begun building out a new streaming center that will help us bring [i]Write Warz[/i] to life in even more exciting ways. Expect live matches, developer streams, special events, and chaos-fueled storytelling like never before. Here’s a sneak peek of construction progress!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979424/0887e960f2cb027b87e272a3953e0f50d9a63a13.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Rewards:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Exclusive avatar unlock: [b]Bumbly[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Special cosmetics only available during this event[/p][/*][*][p]Limited-time titles, colors, and badges[/p][/*][/list][h3]

notes.title: Write Warz v01.03.00 – Bonus Word System Overhaul, UI Upgrades, and more!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi Word Warriors![/b][/h1][p]
[/p][h3]Write Warz v01.03.00 is here – and it’s a BIG one.[/h3][p]
[/p][h2]Bonus Word System Overhaul[/h2][p]
We’ve completely redesigned how bonus words work to make it easier and more rewarding. Now, every bonus word is worth +15 points by default (excluding Plot Point events or Pirate Contracts). No more protected boxes, no more guesswork. This lays the foundation for a much bigger bonus system overhaul next patch.
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Vixen Rework[/h2][p]
We’ve reworked how Vixen’s ability triggers. Instead of destroying bonus boxes before a round (which made prediction and protection tricky), her arrow now strikes **during the writing round**. It’s smoother, cleaner, and gives players a fairer shot.
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Plot Point UI Upgrades[/h2][p]
- [b]Curse of the Mummy’s Tomb[/b] now has a new sprite and panel that rises in from the side.  
- [b]Moonlit Inspiration[/b] has been visually refreshed.  
- [b]Mysterious Stranger[/b] now appears on the [i]right side[/i] for clarity and consistency.
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Rum Function Update[/h2][p]
We’ve adjusted how Rum works! Now it "rummifies" one random bonus word in your list. That word becomes trickier to use—but nets a slightly higher reward if you pull it off. This is a precursor to a full Rum system overhaul coming soon.
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Bot AI is Now Remote[/h2][p]
All AI bots are now hosted server-side! This:
- Reduces load on your machine  
- Speeds up generation  
- Shrinks the game size dramatically (see backend notes below)

This is phase 1 of a smarter, more optimized AI experience.
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Art & Audio[/h2][p]
- Updated [b]epilepsy warning screen[/b] art  
- New [b]horror intermission track[/b] added
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]
- Added missing credits to character variants  
- Fixed typo in the [i]Ethereal[/i] Character Icon  
- Bonus words now highlight properly in finished stories  
- Fixed "Are You Sure?" prompt occasionally sticking in Round Robin
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Backend & Performance[/h2][p]
- Game size reduced from ~10GB to ~2GB (!!)  
- Massive refactor of our Theme System to allow faster new theme rollouts
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]What’s Coming Next?[/h2][h3]Bonus Word Multipliers – Part 2 of the Overhaul[/h3][p]
Next update will add a **multiplier system** to bonus words! If you use multiple prompted words and win the round, you’ll unlock a compounding bonus (up to 3x). Bonus words are about to get strategic.
[/p][p]
[/p][h3]New Limited Time Mode: Bumbly’s Rockin’ Adventure[/h3][p]
If Mad Libs, Write Warz, and Guitar Hero had a baby... it would look weird—but it would play like this. Coming soon.
[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Twitch Streamer Mode[/h3][p]
We're integrating Twitch voting! Streamers will soon be able to invite our custom bot into their channel so their audience can vote on story sentences in real-time.
[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Character Ability Overhaul[/h3][p]
Our current character abilities are… fine. But they’re about to get [i]impactful[/i]. This overhaul will make abilities feel strategic, game-changing, and worth building your playstyle around.
[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Season 1: Elves vs Samurai[/h3][p]
Our first full theme season is coming. Bigger gameplay changes, fantasy storytelling, and new progression systems await. But first, we’re locking in all our core systems.
[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Marketplace & Season Pass Redesign[/h3][p]
Yes, our current store and pass UI needs love—and it's finally getting it. Three new designs are in the works to completely overhaul the player experience.
[/p][p]
[b]– Boltz Entertainment[/b]
[/p]

notes.title: Write Warz – v01.01.00 Update
notes.content:
Hi Word Warriors!

We have a huge update for you all today!

[h3]NEW GAME MODE: ROUND ROBIN MODE[/h3]

Round Robin Mode is now fully launched and packed with updates based on community feedback!

[b]What is Round Robin Mode?[/b]
In this mode, players build a shared story—[i]one sentence at a time[/i]. Each player writes a sentence, then passes the story along to someone else. As long as the story is staying active you will continue to get the story back after at least 2 additional sentences have been added to the story.

[b]Here’s how it works:[/b]

[list]
[*] You’re dropped into a story mid-flow and asked to continue it with a single sentence.
[*] Story timers range from 4 hours to 1 week—completely randomized.
[*] Once your turn ends, the story continues with a new writer.
[*] When the story ends, all contributors vote on their favorite sentences in categories like Best Sentence, Plot Twist, and Funniest Moment.
[*] Meet Clocky! Our new in-game assistant gives smart writing tips based on where you are in the story (beginning, middle, or end).
[/list]

This mode is perfect for those who want a slower, more collaborative, and low-pressure way to play. Whether you're building tension, tossing in chaos, or closing out an epic tale—Round Robin rewards creativity at every turn.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979424/a93e15d1d09bc035e0cff6dfba05fba08dd7efb1.png[/img]

[list] 
[*] When he appears, you’ll be offered 3 mysterious words to use in your next sentence.
[*] 2 are safe and offer a bonus if used.
[*] 1 is cursed—choose it, and you’ll lose a chunk of your points.
[*] Use 1 or 2 of the words at your own risk. Choose wisely…
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979424/a4d3c745e2ce1fa9fcda07683f445bdaabe728b6.png[/img]

[h3]VISUAL & UI IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

[list]
[*] Updated character art

[*] Changed voting button font for improved readability
[*] Resized Pirate voting buttons to match Horror theme

[*] Added slider to adjust main menu music and UI sound effects

[*] Fixed font brightness issue in the writing input field
[*] Fixed grammar mistakes in Horror stock sentences
[*] Fixed tooltip positioning for the Plank in the shop
[*] Fixed layering issue with Cannons and Lost in the Fog
[*] Fixed bug in Morgana’s Pirate challenge that allowed text to overflow the writing box
[*] Fixed bug in Mummy’s Curse where bottom 3 players didn’t see the bonus word box
[*] Updated profanity list
[*] Fixed bug preventing new font colors from updating in the Scriptorium
[*] Removed the Treasure Map plot point from Pirate (being redesigned)
[/list]

[h3]WHAT'S NEXT[/h3]

We're not done yet! Here’s what’s coming soon in upcoming updates:

[list]
[*] Twitch Integration – Let stream viewers vote on sentences live
[*] AI Overhaul – Smarter, funnier, and more context-aware bots
[*] Text-to-Speech – Hear your story come to life, one ridiculous line at a time
[*] A mysterious new Limited Time Mode inspired by Bumbly’s undying love for rock 'n roll 🎸
[/list]

There’s a lot more coming to Write Warz, and we can’t wait for you to be part of the story—one sentence at a time.

[b]– Boltz Entertainment[/b]

notes.title: Write Warz Early Access Launch - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Ahoy, storytellers! The wait is over — Write Warz has officially set sail into Early Access! 🚀

We want to extend a massive thank you to everyone who supported us on Kickstarter and helped us test throughout our demo phase. Your feedback, creativity, and dedication have been invaluable, and we can’t wait to continue this journey with you.

Now, let’s dive into everything new in this Early Access launch!

[b][h3]New Writing Pass & Market[/h3][/b]
Each season will introduce a brand new Writing Pass featuring two new characters, a brand-new theme, and tons of skins, fonts, colors, and more to unlock. Level up to earn more rewards!

[b][h3]High Seas Adventure Theme Arrives[/h3][/b]
ARGH Maties! Pirates have invaded Write Warz, bringing rum, cannonballs, and plenty of high seas chaos. Take on the role of a pirate captain, managing your ship, crew, and resources while writing your way to legendary status. Sing-alongs, sea monsters, buried treasure, and more await!

[u]Port Trading & Economy[/u] 💰 
Before each round, visit a port where you can buy & sell goods. Each port has specialties, meaning some items will sell for more, while others will be cheaper to buy.

[u]Port Items & Mechanics[/u]
🪙 Doubloons – Earned through writing, voting, winning rounds, and selling goods. Convert them to points at the end for extra strategy!
🪵 Planks – Used to repair ship damage from attacks or failed plot points. Ports charge high repair fees, so stock up!
💣 Cannonballs – Attack your opponents! Blast their screens with water & random letters while they try to write.
🍹 Rum – Scramble your bonus word into a piratey version. If used, it’s worth extra points!
🍊 Citrus – Adds 5 extra seconds to your timer when you run out of time (Max 1 per round).
🎯 Bounties – Purchase Word Bonus bounties to use in your next sentence for extra points!

[b][h3]More Custom Game Options![/h3][/b] [list]
[*] Single Round Voting – Move all voting into one large round instead of separate voting phases. Perfect for groups who want to read and discuss stories together.
[*] Map Rotation – Matchmaking now rotates between themes every hour!

notes.title: Check out our new characters, Faye and Brighthorn!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We just wanted to share the newest characters we’ve been working on: Faye and Brighthorn! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7Vy-2eyguuM

[b]New Character:[/b] Faye
[b]Ability:[/b] Pixie’s Prank

When Faye wins a round, one of her playful fairy friends will sweep across the screen, scattering magical fairy dust on all players. This dust causes chaotic, trippy visuals –  distorting colors and scrambling non-protected bonus or player-specific words.

Players must decode and use these distorted words in their next writing round, or Faye gains [b]+5 points[/b] for each word left unused (which is capped at 2 points per player). Meanwhile, other players who successfully unscramble and use their words will earn [b]+5 bonus points[/b] per word.

This effect kicks in right after the score summary ends to keep the game flowing smoothly!

[b]Gameplay Improvements and Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Word Bonuses UI:[/b] Boxes are now wider, and words appear larger for better readability.

[*] [b]Plot Point Selection Overhaul:[/b] Now, each player is assigned a unique plot point in the prequel round with a specific prequel word. Winning the round triggers your assigned plot point!

[*] [b]Voting Bats Reduced:[/b] Lowered to improve performance and reduce lag.

[*] [b]Round Timing Adjustments:[/b] Added +5 seconds to the first few rounds to improve pacing.

[*] [b]10-round Games:[/b] Rounds 1-4 now have 50 seconds, with time incrementing by 5 seconds each round after.

[*] [b]6-round Games:[/b] Rounds 1-3 have 50 seconds, with time incrementing by 5 seconds in later rounds.

[*] [b]Better Story Visibility:[/b] The story text will never be blocked by sentence suggestions.

[*] [b]Keyboard Voting:[/b] You can now vote by pressing keys 1-6 instead of clicking.

[*] [b]Transition Improvements:[/b] Fixed bug where letters could be typed during transition away from the writing panel.

[*] [b]Cursor Lock:[/b] Cursor will only lock when in exclusive fullscreen mode.

[*] [b]Bot Voting Timing:[/b] Bots no longer go over time during voting.

[*] [b]Start Sentence Fix:[/b] You can now enter a start sentence after lobby creation.

[*] [b]Plot Point Adjustments:[/b] Improved processing of plot point sentences to avoid accidental retries on failed attempts.

[*] [b]AI and Lobby Stability:[/b] Resolved issues with AI sentence processing and lobby player visibility when someone leaves.[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ignus Character Update:[/b] Changed Ignus’s burn letters to less common ones, making it easier for players to switch their words.

[*] [b]Kira Autocorrect Symbol Resized:[/b] Rescaled to match the new UI; more Kira updates are coming soon!

[*] [b]Ability Information Streamlined:[/b] Now only one ability text explanation will appear per round to reduce screen clutter.[/list]
But that’s not all! We also have another character in the works: Brighthorn! Learn more about him here:

https://youtu.be/63bNj4obv5Q 
[b][u]New Changes[/u][/b]

Here are the new changes in the [b]latest update[/b]!
[list]
[*] Voting Bats are now less laggy.
[*] Sentence suggestions will now  never cover the story.
[*] Cursor is now only locked to the game when on Exclusive Fullscreen.
[*] Tweaked AI Voting Prompt.
[*] Added more words/phrases to the bot retry list.
[*] Game UI should look much better on non-16:9 or 16:10 screens.
[*] Now only one ability text per round.
[*] Replaced Brighthorn's Base Portrait with the final version.
[*] Replaced Keystroke's icon sprite.
[*] Profanity filter used to check usernames is much smaller with more intense words.
[*] Names from Steam are no longer cut off, but now just shrink instead.
[*] Tweaked the scary background.
[*] Window resizing no longer available in windowed mode.
[*] Fixed – AI bots going over voting time.
[*] Fixed – Not being able to type the starting sentence after the lobby is created.
[*] Fixed – Lobby settings not being copied correctly when switching between 6 and 10 rounds.
[*] Fixed – Plot point sentences continuing to generate after the sentence gets put into the story.
[*] Fixed – AI sentence processing bug.
[*] Fixed – Players box in lobby being cleared out when someone leaves the lobby.
[*] Fixed – Keystroke bug where points would sometimes be double counted.
[*] Fixed – Voting portal sound being desynced from the animation.
[*] Fixed – Kira's autocorrect disable symbol being off scale with the regular one.
[*] Fixed – Curse of the Mummy's ankh laser firing at the wrong spot.
[*] Fixed – Selecting the lowest resolution when selecting highest resolution.
[*] Fixed – Name clipping in bar breakdown.[/list]
[u][b]Character Art Timelapse[/b][/u]

We also recently shared a timelapse of character art for an upcoming character, [b]Dr. Alistair "Chronos" Caldwell[/b] – planned to join the game during the Noir story theme season. Did you know that all art included in [i]Write Warz[/i] is hand-drawn? Our art team works hard to create striking and unique art for each character, so we wanted to share a look at their process:

https://youtu.be/OJ26b7vm29I 
[b]Background:[/b] A brilliant physicist and inventor, Dr. Alistair Caldwell dedicated his life to unlocking the secrets of time travel. After years of tireless research, he finally achieved his goal, creating a device capable of traversing the timestream. Now known as "Chronos," Alistair has embarked on a series of temporal adventures, witnessing firsthand the great events of history and exploring the unknown reaches of the future.

[b]Personality:[/b] Alistair is a curious and inquisitive soul, driven by a thirst for knowledge and a desire to unravel the mysteries of time itself. He possesses a keen intellect and a knack for thinking outside the box, allowing him to approach problems from unexpected angles. Despite his brilliance, Alistair is also a deeply private individual, often keeping his true motivations and goals hidden from even his closest friends.

[b]Skills:[/b] As a time traveler, Alistair possesses an unrivaled understanding of the intricacies of temporal mechanics and the flow of history. His knowledge of future events and advanced technology make him a valuable asset in any situation, while his ability to move through time allows him to gather crucial information, prevent disasters, and even manipulate events to suit his own ends.

We hope you enjoy the new character and update! Let us know if you have any ideas for other characters you would like to see in upcoming seasons :) 

– Boltz Entertainment

[*] Valthrax now gains double points for burning Good Judgement and can burn his own.
[/list]

[h2][b]Good Judgement in Write Warz:[/b][/h2]

Good Judgement is an essential mechanic in Write Warz that rewards players for voting on the sentence that ends up winning the round. It’s not just about earning points but also about shaping the story by choosing the sentence that best fits the narrative. Choosing wisely ensures that the story flows seamlessly and that you stay competitive in the game, even if your own sentences aren’t always the winning ones.

Before: Good Judgement previously had a base value of 15 points. Each time you voted correctly, this stacked with a 2x and eventually a 3x multiplier, allowing players to earn up to 45 points per round just for voting for the best sentence. This system has been in a good spot, so we're not adjusting the point values. However, if you win a round (since you can’t vote for yourself), or if you vote for the wrong sentence, you lose your Good Judgement points. This mechanic keeps you in the game and competitive, even when your sentences aren’t always on top.

After: We’ve made visual changes to streamline the Good Judgement system. Instead of cluttering the screen with the 1x icon, we’ve removed it (you’ll still get your 15 points) and now it will jump straight to the 2x icon for a cleaner display.

Good Judgement Adjustments: This update simplifies the interface without altering the core function, making it easier to track your Good Judgement multipliers while continuing to reward smart voting. Choose wisely to influence the story and gain the advantage!

notes.title: Write Warz Version 1.1 Update: New Features and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Write Warz Version 1.1 Changelog

Version 1.1 is out! Here’s what’s new and improved:

Enhanced Clarity on Play Options:

Core Gameplay Experience: Write Warz is fundamentally a party game, best enjoyed with 3-6 human players. We’ve received valuable feedback and understand that, as a new genre, it can sometimes be challenging to grasp. We're committed to improving this experience.

Invite Friends: If you have friends who enjoy crafting stories or sharing a good laugh, invite them to join your custom lobby. Our code system works similarly to Jackbox or Marvel Snap, making it easy to connect with friends.

Online Matchmaking: While online matchmaking will be available in Early Access, we’re currently focusing on building our community to ensure a seamless experience. In the meantime, join our Discord to connect with other players and find games.

New Features and Improvements:

Steam Friend Invites: You can now directly invite your friends into your custom lobby through Steam!
Social Buttons Added: We’ve added social buttons to the main menu to help you easily connect with our community, find games, and chat with other players.

Character Ability Tooltips: Tooltips for character abilities now only appear when hovering over the icon, rather than the entire character card. This change provides better clarity when selecting your champion.

Widescreen Monitor Support: We’ve temporarily fixed widescreen monitor support. Full widescreen support will be implemented during our Early Access phase.

General Bug Fixes:

UI Layering Issues: We’ve fixed some layering issues with UI elements—just a bit of technical housekeeping on our end.

Dialogue Boxes: Fixed an issue where dialogue boxes were disappearing inconsistently. Oops! We deleted those too fast.

Witching Hour Plot Point Fixes:

Timing Text: Resolved an issue where the timing text wasn’t showing “0” during Witching Hour.
Potion Animation: The potion in the Witching Hour Plot Point now moves and spins faster for a more dynamic experience.

Player Status Text: Added new text to indicate when a player is waiting for others during the Witching Hour Plot Point.

We hope these changes enhance your gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support, and don’t forget to join our Discord to connect with other players and share your stories!

Join our community: www.discord.gg/writewarz

Happy storytelling!
The Boltz Entertainment Team
